topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I can hardly believe what I'm seeing. The spot where I planted that little sapling, a promise to the future, now stands bare. It was meant to grow alongside us, a symbol of time and life, witnessing the laughter and the silent moments. I remember the sun that day, warm and hopeful, as we packed the soil around its roots. Now, the ground looks disturbed, and my heart aches. I wish I could go back, stand by that tree, and protect it. But all I can do is stand here, staring at the empty space, wondering how it could have happened and what I might have missed.
